concepts.name: Unit 2|Africa & The Colonial Experience
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 2|Africa & the Colonial Experience (1880s -1960s) 25 • What does colonialism mean? Brainstorming Colonialism is defined as the direct and total dominance of one country by another based on the possession of state authority by a foreign power
concepts.deep_explanation: It occurs when one country subjugates another, conquering and exploiting its people
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Unit 2|Africa & the Colonial Experience  from page 33.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Unit 2|Africa & the Colonial Experience  with adjacent topics in Chapter 2.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Unit 2|Africa & the Colonial Experience (1880s -1960s) 25 • What does colonialism mean? Brainstorming Colonialism is defined as the direct and total dominance of one country by another based on the possession of state authority by a foreign power (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] It occurs when one country subjugates another, conquering and exploiting its people — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።
